summary: Theorem 3.3(1), proof (page 7): The proof of Theorem 3.3(1) asserts “J² = I” while simultaneously claiming that (J²)* = –I. This is contradictory: the adjoint of the identity is the identity, not –I. Moreover, a real Banach space acquires a complex structure precisely when J² = –I (see the definition on page 4). The correct statement should be J² = –I, which is consistent with the later argument t
